description.value:
Using Tinker's Tools or another type of Artisan's Tools with which you have Proficient, you can take a Magic action to create a Reanimated Companion (see the stat block) through the power of necromancy and science. The companion manifests in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You determine the companion's appearance; your choices don't affect the companion's game statistics.

The companion is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys you. It lasts until you finish a Long Rest or until you take a Magic action to dismiss it early, at which point it harmlessly collapses into a pile of viscera. It immediately drops to 0 Hit Points and dies if you die.

Once you create a companion, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest or expend a spell slot to create one. You can have only one companion at a time and can't create one while your companion is present.

  • The Companion in Combat. The Reanimated Companion shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. If you are small enough to ride it, you can direct it to use its movement on your turn (no action required). It otherwise prioritizes following you and defending you from threats and then itself. If you take a Bonus Action on your turn, you can command it to take specific actions. These actions can be one in its stat block or some other action and can be taken during your turn rather than the companion's.
